name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Adopt **stake-weighted confidence drop thresholds** with a **$25 projected cost cap per link** to prioritize high-impact fixes first. This forces us to quantify risk and reward, ensuring we don’t waste effort on low-value links while still hitting the +5% daily coverage target. The trade-off is slower progress on low-stakes links, but the data shows 80% of value comes from 20% of links—this keeps us focused on the right work.

name: Scriv
text: The $25 cap risks underfunding high-impact fixes—if a single link’s resolution costs $30 but blocks a critical path, the threshold forces us to skip it, capping coverage at 95% while the bus task stalls. Instead, set a **$50/$5% threshold**: cap per-link spend at $50 but trigger a triage override if the link’s impact exceeds 5% of the total risk pool. Settle it by running a 24-hour pilot on the top 10 highest-impact links—if coverage drops below +4%/day or any bus task stalls, the override triggers.
